subject: Where can I download the Exercise Files on the mirt vignette website?

messages.author: b5f242e7eb90c7c9
messages.subject: Where can I download the Exercise Files on the mirt vignette website?
parts:
Hi, I am new to the group and to the mirt package. I have read at the relevant paper in the Journal of Statistical Software and it seems a very useful programme and it is an important contribution to the IRT community.

I am trying to learn the mirt library and on this website (http://philchalmers.github.io/mirt/mirt-vignettes.html), Phil has given many useful examples. There are exercise on the page too. I wonder if anyone knows where I can download the datafile related to Exercise 1-4? It will be useful for me to practise how to use the software.

Thank you very much!

Regards,
Chester Kam

messages.author: 70d0917afd869432
messages.subject: Re: Where can I download the Exercise Files on the mirt vignette website?
parts:
Hi Chester,

I've uploaded the datafiles here: https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/30825176/mirt%20Exercise%20Datafiles.zip

Best,
Matt

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Where can I download the Exercise Files on the mirt vignette website?
parts:
Thanks Matt. Just for completeness (and in case you anyone was wondering how these example datasets were constructed), all the example, exercises, and vignette code are available on the 'gh-page' branch at the Github repository. https://github.com/philchalmers/mirt/tree/gh-pages. The code used to generate the exercise files is under the data-scripts/ directory. Cheers.

Phil
